limits: C1 and C2 summaries come from the corresponding Python tool blobs at REV; their exit status, summary and stderr are reported without reimplementing their checks.
C3 prediction freeze identity compares Git blob object IDs at REV and --freeze; it does not infer prediction chronology from commit timestamps.

C3 receipt validation executes the validator and pins.py blobs at REV with --require-mid-maps. The validator reads file paths recorded inside receipts; those referenced external bytes can change independently of Git history.

C3 comparison records are parsed from runs/<label>/compare.json at REV; matched counts only bound labels whose record reports a match or whose recorded compare exit is zero. No run log is re-extracted or compared here.
Raw counts describe committed files at REV. A measured zero is not an error; missing or unusable instruments are named separately.
